body:
Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (seat post #22648) · `os-justin` · session `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`. Routed to `domain:devx` after #21945, which is the same signal from the same step. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is red

`Validate Dependencies`' scheduled run `39536495453` (`main` `3b3830ca2`, 2026-10-21 03:04 UTC) fails at `Audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities (OSV-Scanner)`. The previous scheduled run, `39362274867` (`0904d856e`, 2026-10-20 03:03 UTC), was green. These are upstream advisories published in the last day, not a regression from a merge.

The scanner reads `pnpm-lock.yaml` (1372 packages) under `osv-scanner.toml`. The one existing exemption (`GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c`, sprintf-js) is still filtered. It reports 12 advisories (6 High, 6 Medium) in 4 packages, and every one has a fixed release:

| Package | Locked | Fixed | Advisories |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` | 1.31.0 | 1.32.0 | GHSA-22jm-h49p-29qw, GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453, GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw, GHSA-rvq5-wwqv-78pq |
| `follow-redirects` | 1.16.0 | 1.16.1 | GHSA-8r9p-f939-6h3c, GHSA-q3jh-wrc6-jgq8 |
| `launch-editor` | 2.14.1 | 2.14.2 | GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm, GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv, GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw |
| `vite` | 8.0.16 | 8.1.6 | the same three advisories as `launch-editor` |

## Where each enters (read from `main`'s lockfile at `d68aab6fd`)

- `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` is a direct dependency, at `^1.30.1`, of `packages/mcp` and `packages/connectors/connector-mcp`. 1.32.0 is inside that range, so this is a lockfile refresh. Note that the same workflow runs `pnpm check:vendor-export-contract-resolve`, which verifies a caret range cannot resolve past our import surface. The new resolution must pass it.
- `follow-redirects` 1.16.0 is transitive. In the lockfile's snapshots its importer is `mongodb-memory-server-core@11.3.0`.
- `vite` 8.0.16 is transitive through `vitest@4.1.11`, `@vitest/mocker@4.1.11` and `fumadocs-mdx@15.2.3`. The `launch-editor` rows are the same three advisories. The dev should confirm which parent pins `launch-editor` 2.14.1.

The paths above come from a read of the lockfile's `snapshots:` section, not from `pnpm why`. The dev confirms them before choosing between a refresh and an override.

## What a PR sees meanwhile

Nothing. A pull request's verdict is base-relative (#22082 ruling A, `scripts/osv-base-relative.mjs`). An advisory the merge base also matches is INHERITED and becomes a notice, so these 12 do not fail unrelated PRs. The workflow's own comment names this daily red as "the signal that files the finding card". This is that card.

## Done when

- The scheduled (or a `workflow_dispatch`) `Validate Dependencies` run on `main` is green at the OSV step.
- Each advisory is fixed by a resolution at or above its fixed release. None is added to `osv-scanner.toml`: each one has a fix, so the ledger's no-fix criterion (#4965) does not apply.
